metadata.prompt: Superhero movies (Marvel and DC films). Facts about superhero films, actors and release years, each tied to a specific film. questions.question: Andrew Garfield played Peter Parker in Sam Raimi's 2002 film 'Spider-Man'.
questions.explanation: Tobey Maguire played Peter Parker in Sam Raimi's 2002 'Spider-Man'; Andrew Garfield took the role later, in 'The Amazing Spider-Man' (2012).
questions.fact: Tobey Maguire starred as Peter Parker in the 2002 film 'Spider-Man', directed by Sam Raimi.

questions.question: Robert Downey Jr. starred as Tony Stark in the 2008 film 'Iron Man'.
questions.explanation: Robert Downey Jr. played Tony Stark in 'Iron Man' (2008), the film that launched the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
questions.fact: Robert Downey Jr. played Tony Stark in the 2008 film 'Iron Man'.

questions.question: Marvel Studios' film 'The Avengers', directed by Joss Whedon, was released in 2010.
questions.fact: Marvel Studios' 'The Avengers', directed by Joss Whedon, was released in 2012.

questions.question: The 2019 Marvel film 'Captain Marvel' became the first female-led superhero film to gross over $1 billion worldwide.
questions.explanation: 'Captain Marvel' grossed over $1.1 billion worldwide, the first female-led superhero film to pass the billion-dollar mark.
questions.fact: 'Captain Marvel' (2019) grossed over $1.1 billion worldwide, making it the first female-led superhero film to pass $1 billion.

questions.question: The 2019 DC film 'Shazam!' was directed by James Wan.
questions.explanation: 'Shazam!' was directed by David F. Sandberg. James Wan directed DC's 'Aquaman' (2018).
questions.fact: The 2019 film 'Shazam!' was directed by David F. Sandberg.

questions.question: The 2018 Marvel film 'Black Panther' won three Academy Awards.
questions.explanation: 'Black Panther' won Oscars for Best Costume Design, Best Production Design and Best Original Score.
questions.fact: 'Black Panther' (2018) won three Academy Awards: Best Costume Design, Best Production Design and Best Original Score.

questions.question: Heath Ledger played the Joker in the 2008 film 'The Dark Knight'.
questions.explanation: Heath Ledger played the Joker in Christopher Nolan's 'The Dark Knight' (2008) and won a posthumous Oscar for the role.
questions.fact: Heath Ledger portrayed the Joker in Christopher Nolan's 2008 film 'The Dark Knight'.

questions.question: Chris Evans played Steve Rogers in the 2011 film 'Captain America: The First Avenger'.
questions.explanation: Chris Evans first played Steve Rogers, alias Captain America, in 'Captain America: The First Avenger' (2011).
questions.fact: Chris Evans starred as Steve Rogers / Captain America in 'Captain America: The First Avenger' (2011).

questions.question: Joaquin Phoenix won the Academy Award for Best Actor for his role in the 2019 film 'Joker'.
questions.explanation: Joaquin Phoenix won the Best Actor Oscar at the 2020 Academy Awards for playing Arthur Fleck in 'Joker'.
questions.fact: Joaquin Phoenix won the Academy Award for Best Actor for 'Joker' (2019).

questions.question: Christopher Reeve first played Superman in the film 'Superman', which was released in 1982.
questions.explanation: 'Superman', starring Christopher Reeve in the title role for the first time, was released in 1978, not 1982.
questions.fact: Christopher Reeve first played Superman in 'Superman', released in 1978.

questions.question: The 2019 Marvel film 'Captain Marvel' had its world premiere in Paris.
questions.explanation: 'Captain Marvel' premiered in London on February 27, 2019, not in Paris.
questions.fact: 'Captain Marvel' premiered in London on February 27, 2019.

questions.question: In the 2019 Marvel film 'Captain Marvel', Gemma Chan plays Carol Danvers' best friend Maria Rambeau.
questions.explanation: Maria Rambeau is played by Lashana Lynch; Gemma Chan plays the Kree sniper Minn-Erva.
questions.fact: In 'Captain Marvel' (2019), Lashana Lynch plays Maria Rambeau and Gemma Chan plays Minn-Erva.

questions.question: Christian Bale played Bruce Wayne in the 2005 film 'Batman Begins'.
questions.explanation: Christian Bale starred as Bruce Wayne / Batman in Christopher Nolan's 'Batman Begins' (2005).
questions.fact: Christian Bale played Bruce Wayne / Batman in the 2005 film 'Batman Begins'.

questions.question: In the 2018 Marvel film 'Avengers: Infinity War', the villain Thanos is played by Jason Momoa.
questions.explanation: Thanos is played by Josh Brolin, while Jason Momoa is known for playing DC's Aquaman.
questions.fact: Josh Brolin played Thanos in the 2018 film 'Avengers: Infinity War'.

questions.question: The 2017 Marvel film 'Thor: Ragnarok' was directed by Taika Waititi.
questions.explanation: New Zealand filmmaker Taika Waititi directed 'Thor: Ragnarok', released in 2017.
questions.fact: Taika Waititi directed the 2017 Marvel Studios film 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

questions.question: The 2017 DC film 'Wonder Woman', starring Gal Gadot, was directed by Kathryn Bigelow.
questions.explanation: The 2017 'Wonder Woman' film was directed by Patty Jenkins, not Kathryn Bigelow.
questions.fact: Patty Jenkins directed the 2017 DC film 'Wonder Woman'.

questions.question: Tim Burton's film 'Batman', starring Michael Keaton as the title hero, was released in 1992.
questions.explanation: Tim Burton's 'Batman' came out in 1989; its sequel 'Batman Returns' was released in 1992.
questions.fact: Tim Burton's 'Batman', starring Michael Keaton, was released in 1989.

questions.question: The 2019 Marvel film 'Captain Marvel' borrowed elements from the 1971 'Kree–Skrull War' comic book storyline written by Roy Thomas.
questions.explanation: The film's writers drew on Roy Thomas's 1971 'Kree–Skrull War' storyline, which pits the Kree against the shape-shifting Skrulls.
questions.fact: 'Captain Marvel' (2019) borrowed elements from Roy Thomas's 1971 'Kree–Skrull War' comic book storyline.
